units.source_text: 可是，浓雾始终遮挡在我眼前。

en.t: But the thick fog kept blocking the view before my eyes.

units.source_text: 当然也不是完全看不见，时而也能从雾里依稀看到粗壮的山毛榉和葱葱郁郁的枞树枝，以及放牧的牛马。

en.t: Of course it was not that I could see nothing at all; now and then, through the mist, I could faintly make out stout beeches, lush fir branches, and grazing cattle and horses.

units.source_text: 不过，这景物都只是匆匆一瞥，就又消失在浓雾里了。

en.t: Yet all of these sights were only brief glimpses, and then they vanished again into the dense fog.

units.source_text: 没过多久，走的双腿疲惫，肚子也咕咕叫了——被浓雾打湿了的登山服和绒毯都变得愈加沉重。

en.t: Before long, my legs were tired from walking and my stomach was growling; my climbing clothes and blanket, soaked by the thick fog, grew heavier and heavier.

units.source_text: 我不得不认输了，只能顺着岩石被水流击打的声音向着梓川峡谷方向前进。

en.t: I had no choice but to admit defeat and move on toward the Azusa River gorge, following the sound of water striking the rocks.
